trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Investigated**: `list_deployments` showed v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy, and the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: First rollback attempt partially failed (completed only in us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollout — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is healthy again in all regions, with error rate down from 18% to ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. (First attempt timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key to avoid duplicates.)

Note: v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified, since it has never been healthy in production.
